sources.title: StreamingBench (Lin et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: First comprehensive streaming-video MLLM bench: 900 videos / 4,500 QA / 18 tasks in 3 categories (real-time visual, omni-source incl. audio, contextual incl. streaming interaction + proactive output); timestamped mid-stream queries; best model (Gemini 1.5 Pro) 67.07% vs human 91.66% (author-measured); code+data open.
claims.context: Full-paper abstract; numbers paper-reported at report date.

claims.text: Streaming-eval contract distinct from offline long-context; also serves the omni audio-visual eval role (R6 node 5).
claims.context: Edition-level analytical synthesis by the Work operator (lineage/selection/boundary/contract judgment, not a literal statement of the cited source); structural home for edition rationale.

limitations.text: Most models evaluated via offline conversion; true online-system scores need Flash-VStream-side sources.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.finding: Full body consumed: timestamped-query design, omni-source category, and baseline gaps verified.
